primary_question: Do frozen gates reduce escaped semantic defects relative to ungated acceptance?
requirements: candidate provenance and source hashes frozen before gate application
G1/G2/G3 policies fixed before holdout access
holdout Java oracle inputs and outputs unavailable during development and gate tuning
paired gate decisions and oracle outcomes for same candidate
method-cluster uncertainty estimates; no case-level independence assumption

outcomes.escaped_defect: gate ACCEPT and holdout oracle FAIL
outcomes.false_rejection: gate REJECT and holdout oracle PASS

limitations: No gate superiority or prospective results until independently sourced holdout and decisions are recorded
